caption:
Good speech: one instruction for every chat today

Allah gives one clear instruction about the way we talk to each other. Let it shape every message, call and conversation you have today.

Surah Al-Isra 17:53

Pick one conversation today and choose the best words for it.

#speech #goodwords #muslimhabits #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: Tell My slaves that they should say what is best, for Satan sows discord among them. Indeed, Satan is a sworn enemy to mankind (Surah Al-Israa 17:53)
